lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h1>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">Command 用来快速调用 ZCode Agent 的内置能力，也可以保存常用提示词。把重复使用的代码审查、提交说明、发布检查、文件解释等提示词保存成命令后，就可以在输入框里通过 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">/</code> 快速调用。</p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">Command 围绕 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">ZCode Agent</strong> 工作流设计。日常在 ZCode 里使用时，可以把团队反复使用的任务提示词沉淀成命令，让自研 Agent 更稳定地执行固定流程。</p>
<p class="flex gap-4 text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><img src="/content/docs/v2/screenshots/zcode-docs-20260612-command-picker.webp" alt="ZCode Agent 调用命令" class="flex-1 rounded-lg border border-white/10 mb-4 block min-w-0 max-w-full cursor-zoom-in transition-opacity hover:opacity-90"/></p>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="use-in-zcode-agent">在 ZCode Agent 中使用<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<ol class="mb-4 list-decimal list-outside pl-5 text-sm">
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">在输入框输入 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">/</code>，打开命令面板。面板分为 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">命令</strong> 和 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">技能</strong> 两个分组，可以继续输入关键字筛选。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">选择要使用的命令，或继续输入命令名进行筛选。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">如果命令需要参数，可以在命令后继续补充路径、模块名或说明。</li>
</ol>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">ZCode Agent 当前内置两个命令：</p>
<div class="mb-6 overflow-x-auto rounded-md border border-border bg-card"><table class="min-w-full border-collapse text-sm"><thead class="bg-muted/60 text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.1em] text-muted-foreground"><tr class="bg-transparent"><th class="border-b border-border px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground" style="text-align:left">命令</th><th class="border-b border-border px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground" style="text-align:left">用途</th></tr></thead><tbody class="bg-card"><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">/goal</code></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">查看、设置、替换、暂停、恢复或清除当前会话目标，适合持续执行的长任务</td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">/compact</code></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">压缩当前对话上下文，保留关键信息，适合长对话继续推进时使用</td></tr></tbody></table></div>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">例如，在长任务中可以用 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">/compact</code> 整理上下文；需要让 Agent 围绕一个长期目标持续推进时，可以用 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">/goal</code> 设置目标。需要调用技能时，使用 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">$</code> 或在 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">/</code> 面板的 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">技能</strong> 分组中选择。</p>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="create-command">新建 Command<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">在 ZCode 设置中进入 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">命令</strong> 页面，点击新建命令后填写以下内容：</p>
<p class="flex gap-4 text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><img src="/content/docs/v2/screenshots/zcode-docs-20260612-command-create-form.webp" alt="新建命令" class="flex-1 rounded-lg border border-white/10 mb-4 block min-w-0 max-w-full cursor-zoom-in transition-opacity hover:opacity-90"/></p>
<div class="mb-6 overflow-x-auto rounded-md border border-border bg-card"><table class="min-w-full border-collapse text-sm"><thead class="bg-muted/60 text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.1em] text-muted-foreground"><tr class="bg-transparent"><th class="border-b border-border px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground" style="text-align:left">字段</th><th class="border-b border-border px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground" style="text-align:left">说明</th></tr></thead><tbody class="bg-card"><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">作用域</strong></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">选择 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">用户</strong>（所有工作区可用）或 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">工作区</strong>（仅当前项目可用）</td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">名称</strong></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">命令名称，保存后可通过 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">/command-name</code> 调用</td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">描述</strong></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">可选，显示在命令选择器中的简短说明</td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">参数提示</strong></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">可选，用来提示参数格式，例如 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">&lt;file-path&gt;</code></td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">提示词</strong></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">命令真正发送给 Agent 的提示词内容</td></tr></tbody></table></div>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">自定义命令以 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">.md</code> 文件形式保存在 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">~/.zcode/commands</code> 目录（工作区级命令保存在项目目录下）。保存后在任务输入框中通过 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">/command-name</code> 即可调用。</p>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="import-from-external-agent">从外部 Agent 导入命令<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">如果你已经在 Claude Code 等外部 Agent 中维护了一批命令，不需要在 ZCode 里重新创建。在 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">命令</strong> 页面右上角点击 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">从外部 Agent 导入命令</strong>，即可把外部 Agent 已有的命令直接导入到 ZCode 中。</p>
<p class="flex gap-4 text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><img src="/content/docs/v2/screenshots/zcode-docs-20260613-command-import-external.webp" alt="从外部 Agent 导入命令" class="flex-1 rounded-lg border border-white/10 mb-4 block min-w-0 max-w-full cursor-zoom-in transition-opacity hover:opacity-90"/></p>
<ol class="mb-4 list-decimal list-outside pl-5 text-sm">
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">在 ZCode 设置中进入 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">命令</strong> 页面。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">点击右上角的 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">从外部 Agent 导入命令</strong>。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">选择要导入的外部 Agent 命令，确认后即可导入到 ZCode。</li>
</ol>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">导入后的命令会和自建命令一样保存在命令列表中，通过 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">/command-name</code> 调用；你也可以在 ZCode 内继续修改名称、描述、参数提示或提示词内容。</p>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="usage-notes">使用建议<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">如果只是保存一段简单提示词，使用 Command 即可；如果流程需要脚本、模板或示例文件，可以考虑使用 Skill。</p>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="next-steps">下一步<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
